replicate_compare — DRIVE grind op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.replicate_compare(groups: 'dict', log: 'bool' = True) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import grind; grind.replicate_compare(groups: 'dict', log: 'bool' = True) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("replicate_compare"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Lays out the scatter between independent trials and the differences between groups (materials) on the same scale.

groups: name → array of (n_runs, n_conditions) (e.g. D50 for 3 runs × 7 time points per material). n_conditions is the same for all groups. log=True compares after taking ln (scatter of size ratios = close to the coefficient of variation). Returns: spread (group → per-condition mean, sd, cv (SD/mean, original scale), cv_pooled (root mean square of cv), cv_max), separation (pair of groups → per-condition |Δ平均| / √(SE₁² + SE₂²) (SE = SD/√n) and its minimum min_z; keys are strings "名前1|名前2"). Fewer than 2 runs → ValueError.
